## Test Suite for U08_Alarms

**Test Case ID** | **Title** | **Requirement ID** | **Kind** | **Preconditions** | **Inputs** | **Steps** | **Expected**
------- | -------- | -------- | -------- | -------- | -------- | -------- | --------
TC-001 | Low pressure alarm logs onset and reset | RW-SW-85 | Positive | - System is running | - Pressure falls below threshold | - Alarm triggers with high priority | - Alarm logs onset and resets automatically
TC-002 | High pressure alarm triggers with 3 consecutive breaths | RW-SW-88 | Positive | - System is running | - Pressure exceeds threshold for 3 consecutive breaths | - Alarm triggers with high priority | - Alarm remains active until cancelled
TC-003 | High pressure alarm emits sound | RW-SW-89 | Positive | - High pressure alarm is active | - N/A | - Alarm emits sound | - Sound persists until cancelled
TC-004 | High pressure alarm persists even when inactive | RW-SW-90 | Positive | - High pressure alarm is triggered and then inactive | - N/A | - Alarm remains displayed until cancelled | - Alarm remains inactive but visible
TC-005 | Alarm management supports silent alarm state | RW-SW-91 | Positive | - System is running | - N/A | - User selects silent alarm state | - Alarm is visible but silent
TC-006 | PIP too high alarm has high priority | RW-SW-93 | Positive | - System is running | - N/A | - Alarm is set to high priority | - Alarm has high priority
TC-007 | Default PIP too high alarm value is commanded PIP + 5 | RW-SW-94 | Positive | - System is running | - N/A | - Default PIP too high value is set to commanded PIP + 5 | - Default value matches requirement
TC-008 | Invalid input triggers error | RW-SW-86 | Negative | - System is running | - Invalid pressure value | - Alarm does not trigger | - Error message is displayed
